description: This file is a shell script used to test HTTP authentication headers, credential helpers, and interop with a local Git server. It performs various setup steps, mocks credential responses, and runs multiple tests to verify correct behavior of authentication mechanisms including Basic, Bearer, and multi-stage auth with different header continuations and case variations.

methods.name: set_credential_reply
methods.description: Sets the mocked credential reply by writing the credentials to a file, identified by a suffix.

methods.name: expect_credential_query
methods.description: Checks that the credential query output matches the expected credentials.

methods.name: per_test_cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup after each test by removing credential files and temp files.
